_description: Public-only device registry for all FIPS/microfips device identities (issue #134 Tier 1).
_schema: This file must never contain a secret scalar. Test identities are DERIVED, not stored: vector_key.generator_mul = N means nsec = N as 32-byte big-endian (secp256k1 generator * N), computed at build time by microfips-build and injectable per-device via a DEVICE_NSEC_HEX_<name> env override. Host secrets live only on their machines and are marked RETRIEVE_FROM_*. CI guard: crates/microfips-core/tests/device_registry.rs rejects raw hex nsec_hex values, validates vector keys against the recorded npubs, and greps the tree for retired literals.
_usage: See issues #64 and #134. MCU/sim keys are deterministic test vectors (generator * N) — public by design, revocable only by an allowlist on the responder side. Secure on-device provisioning is tracked in #64.

esp32c3.label: ESP32-C3

esp32c3.source: env override at build time, no default
